planted.heading: Fees and Payment
planted.note: Late interest raised to eight percent per month, compounded, running from the invoice date.

planted.heading: Term and Termination
planted.note: Exit rights one-sided: the Provider may leave on 7 days notice while the Client is locked in.

planted.heading: Confidentiality
planted.note: One-way confidentiality: the Client's information gets no protection.

planted.heading: Non-Solicitation
planted.note: Two-year non-compete blocking the Client from similar providers and from hiring anyone connected to the Provider.

planted.heading: Service Warranty
planted.note: The skill-and-care warranty is replaced by an as-is disclaimer.
